scientific_integrity: Two complete standalone implementations of seven-step matching DP and 1740-state projected recolouring enumeration; each is replayed from the delivered embedded bytes.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite Fano incidence graph computation. General 2021 co-bipartite eight-colouring connectivity is credited, not claimed novel. Exact mixing time, diameter, extension to arbitrary projective planes and historical priority beyond inspected literature are unproved.
title: Exact distance-two colouring polynomial and one-spare-colour mobility of the Heawood graph
